privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.s1Body: We may collect account information, basic device information, language and region preferences, and app usage logs to provide and improve our service.
privacyPolicy.s2Body: Your data is used for account authentication, personalized content recommendation, feature quality improvements, and security risk control.
privacyPolicy.s3Body: We do not sell your personal data. Data is only shared with compliant service providers when necessary to operate core functionality.
privacyPolicy.s4Body: You can request to view, update, or delete your personal data. For any request, contact us through the in-app feedback page.

termsPage.title: Terms of Use
termsPage.s1Body: By accessing or using FlashMaple, you agree to these terms and all applicable laws and regulations.
termsPage.s2Body: You are responsible for maintaining account security and all activities under your account. Do not share your credentials.
termsPage.s3Body: You agree not to abuse the service, interfere with normal operation, or publish illegal or harmful content.
termsPage.s4Body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use after updates means you accept the revised terms.

aboutAppPage.title: About us
aboutAppPage.s1Body: FlashMaple helps Canadian immigrants stay informed about local life and practical information, while naturally improving their English through real-world reading.
aboutAppPage.s2Body: The current version supports flash news browsing, category exploration, push notifications, favorites management, multilingual interface switching, mood theme switching, and more.
aboutAppPage.s3Body: If you have suggestions or questions, please send us a message on the feedback page. We review every submission.
aboutAppPage.s4Body: All news content shown in the app is sourced from publicly available online content and is provided for reference only. If any content infringes your rights, please contact us for removal.
aboutAppPage.s5Body: If you would like to learn more about our products, services, and latest updates, please visit our official website

homePage.title: FlashMaple - Canadian Top News for Newcomers
homePage.seoTitle: FlashMaple - Canadian Top News for Newcomers
homePage.seoDescription: Local Canadian news, immigration updates, and regional stories for newcomers. Read in multiple languages and build English through real news from Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal, and beyond.
homePage.intro: Follow local news in Canada, immigration updates, and practical regional information while naturally improving your English through real-world reading.

features.title: Start with what matters now
features.body: A fast briefing for top stories, practical updates, and local alerts — ready when your day starts.

features.title: One feed, many trusted sources
features.body: Explore local news in Canada across immigration, education, health, entertainment, and headlines from trusted sources.

features.title: News that knows where you are
features.body: Choose a Canadian region — from Toronto and Vancouver to Montreal and beyond — to make every briefing more local.

features.title: Read across languages
features.body: Read Canadian news in multiple languages and use real-world stories to strengthen your English.

features.title: Let important stories find you
features.body: Turn on notifications for breaking news and keep the signal close, even when FlashMaple is not open.

features.title: Make it yours
features.body: Save stories, search by keyword, and tune the app to fit your day.

faq.question: Where can newcomers find local news in Canada?
faq.answer: FlashMaple brings together Canadian local news, immigration updates, practical information, and regional stories in one focused feed.

faq.question: Can I change my language and region?
faq.answer: Yes. The app supports multiple interface languages and Canadian regions, and you can change both from Settings.

faq.question: Can I receive breaking news?
faq.answer: Yes. Enable browser notifications from the app to receive timely updates and manage them in Notification Center.

faq.question: Where does the news come from?
faq.answer: FlashMaple brings together trusted Canadian news sources covering local life, immigration, and regional updates. Each story identifies its source and lets you continue to the original report.

faq.question: Can I save and search for stories?
faq.answer: Yes. Save stories you want to revisit and use search to find more news by keyword.

faq.question: How do I add FlashMaple to my home screen?
faq.answer: Add FlashMaple to your home screen for one-tap access and an app-like experience. Open the app and select Add to Home Screen. If no install prompt appears, open your browser’s Share or menu, choose View More, then Add to Home Screen, and confirm Add.
